final: WITH film_counts AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies FROM inventory GROUP BY film_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(copies) AS total_copies FROM film_counts) SELECT film_counts.film_id, film_counts.copies, film_counts.copies * 1.0 / totals.total_copies AS share FROM film_counts JOIN totals ON totals.total_copies IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
